title: Indicate the use of artificial intelligence (AI)
slide_intent: Disclose material AI involvement because readers need to understand how an image’s apparent evidence was made.
strategic_value: Clear disclosure can help Helsinki preserve trust when communications use generated or meaningfully altered visuals.
demonstration: This webpage component gives AI-disclosure instructions, two disclosure phrases, and watermark plus text or audio directions for images, illustrations and video.
practical_value: Apply the disclosure threshold to the production method and meaning of the result.

content_islands.name: Disclosure threshold
content_islands.spec: Keep the fully-generated and meaning-changing modification conditions together.

content_islands.name: Disclosure methods
content_islands.spec: Follow with the phrases and watermark/text/audio methods.

ingredient.name: AI disclosure
ingredient.role: Make a visual’s production method understandable.
ingredient.application: Indicate qualifying AI use in multiple ways, including a watermark and text or audio for the named visual media.
ingredient.scope: Fully generated content or significant AI modification that changes meaning.

reference_purposes.Application: The source supplies disclosure phrases and methods.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Disclosure applies to fully AI-generated content or significant modification that changes meaning, not every minor AI-assisted edit.
